entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of advanced concepts, theories and principles in Biology
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of concepts, theories and principles in Biology
entries.learning_activity: (c) Explain growth process in plants (cell cycle, growth patterns, seed dormancy and viability, and primary and secondary growth)
teaching_learning_activities: Brainstorming: Guide students through think-ink-share to brainstorm on the concept of growth in plants
Group discussion: In manageable groups, guide students to discuss the process of growth in plants
ICT-based learning: Guide students to use animations/video to explore the process of growth in plants
Laboratory practical: Organise and guide students to carry out biological investigations to analyse factors affecting growth of plants
Field trip: Organise and guide students to visit a nearby place where large scale cultivation is done to observe different stages of plant growth
entries.assessment: Growth process in plants is clearly explained
resources: charts/ Diagrams showing various patterns of growth in plants
charts showing meristematic tissues and variety of seeds
entries.references: TIE, Biology for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
